title: EVOLVE: Uncertainty-Aware Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Prediction with Adaptive Prototype Memories
abstract: arXiv:2610.32189v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unsupervised multivariate time series anomaly prediction (AP) aims to estimate future anomaly risks from current observations, providing early-warning signals for proactive intervention and maintenance in complex systems. Existing unsupervised AP methods follow a perturbation-based paradigm, where predefined or random perturbations are injected into historical windows to simulate abnormal future evolution. However, these methods share perturbations across different variables and contexts, and learn deterministic history-to-future evolution. In reality, anomaly evolution is variable- and context-dependent: the same perturbation may be amplified into abnormal future dynamics in one variable or context, while being absorbed as normal fluctuation in another. In addition, future evolution is not uniquely determined by a historical window, since similar histories may lead to multiple plausible trajectories, such as gradual degradation or abrup

translated_title: EVOLVE：基于自适应原型记忆的不确定性感知多变量时间序列异常预测
translated_abstract: 无监督多变量时间序列异常预测（AP）旨在从当前观测中估计未来的异常风险，为复杂系统的主动干预与维护提供早期预警信号。现有无监督AP方法遵循基于扰动的范式，即将预定义或随机扰动注入历史窗口以模拟异常的未来演化。然而，这些方法在不同变量和上下文之间共享扰动，并学习确定性的“从历史到未来”的演化。实际上，异常演化是依赖于变量和上下文的：同一扰动在某个变量或上下文中可能被放大为异常的未来动态，而在另一些情况下则被吸收为正常波动。此外，未来演化并非由历史窗口唯一确定，因为相似的历史可能导向多种合理的发展轨迹，例如逐渐退化或突发故障。
tldr: 提出EVOLVE框架，通过自适应原型记忆实现不确定性感知的多变量时间序列异常预测，能够建模变量与上下文相关的扰动差异，并预见多种可能的未来异常演化轨迹。
en_tdlr: EVOLVE is an uncertainty-aware multivariate time series anomaly prediction framework with adaptive prototype memories that captures variable- and context-dependent perturbation effects and anticipates multiple plausible future evolution trajectories.
